question: What is the total net revenue in the data?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_net_revenue FROM fact_sales

question: How many orders are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS total_orders FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_no NOT LIKE 'C%';

question: How many different products were sold at least once?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How many registered customers placed at least one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) FROM fact_sales WHERE customer_key > 0

question: What is the average order value?
sql: SELECT AVG(line_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How many units were sold in total?
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM fact_sales WHERE quantity > 0

question: How many cancellation invoices are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancellation_count FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = TRUE

question: What is the total value of all cancellations?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS total_cancellations_value FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = TRUE

question: On how many different days did the shop receive at least one order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date_key) AS distinct_days FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: What are the gross sales before cancellations?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS gross_sales FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: Which 5 countries generated the highest net revenue?
sql:
SELECT dc.country_name, SUM(fs.line_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM dim_country dc
JOIN fact_sales fs ON dc.country_key = fs.country_key
WHERE NOT fs.is_cancelled
GROUP BY dc.country_name
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: What are the top 5 products by units sold?
sql: SELECT d_product.description, SUM(f_sales.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM fact_sales f_sales JOIN dim_product d_product ON f_sales.product_key = d_product.product_key GROUP BY d_product.description ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 products by net revenue?
sql: SELECT d_product.description, SUM(f_sales.line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f_sales JOIN dim_product d_product ON f_sales.product_key = d_product.product_key GROUP BY d_product.description ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: From how many countries did the shop receive orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_key) AS country_count FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: How much net revenue came from guest checkouts?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE customer_key = 0

question: Who are the 5 registered customers with the highest net revenue? Give their customer ids.
sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(f.line_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM dim_customer c
JOIN fact_sales f ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE c.customer_key > 0
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: How many orders came from Germany?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS order_count FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key JOIN dim_country dc ON fs.country_key = dc.country_key WHERE dc.country_name = 'Germany'

question: What net revenue did the product 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER' generate?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key WHERE dp.stock_code = 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER';

question: How many products were ordered by customers from more than 20 different countries?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) AS product_count FROM (SELECT product_key, COUNT(DISTINCT country_key) AS country_count FROM fact_sales WHERE customer_key > 0 GROUP BY product_key HAVING country_count > 20) AS subquery;

question: What is the average net revenue per registered customer?
sql: SELECT AVG(line_amount) AS avg_net_revenue_per_customer FROM fact_sales WHERE customer_key > 0 GROUP BY customer_key LIMIT 100;

question: What was the net revenue in each year?
sql: SELECT d.year, SUM(fs.line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM dim_date d JOIN fact_sales fs ON d.date_key = fs.date_key GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year LIMIT 100

question: What was the net revenue of the best month of 2011?
sql: SELECT SUM(fact_sales.line_amount) AS net_revenue, dim_date.month_name FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE dim_date.year = 2011 GROUP BY dim_date.month_name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What was the net revenue in November 2011?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key WHERE dd.year = 2011 AND dd.month = 11

question: What was the net revenue in each quarter of 2011?
sql:
SELECT d.quarter, SUM(f.line_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM dim_date d
JOIN fact_sales f ON d.date_key = f.date_key
WHERE d.year = 2011
GROUP BY d.quarter
ORDER BY d.quarter
LIMIT 100;

question: By how many percent did net revenue grow from 2010 to 2011?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR = 2011 THEN line_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR = 2010 THEN line_amount ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR = 2010 THEN line_amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_growth_percentage FROM fact_sales JOIN dim_date ON fact_sales.date_key = dim_date.date_key WHERE YEAR IN (2010, 2011)

question: How many orders were placed on weekends?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS weekend_orders FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key WHERE dd.is_weekend = TRUE

question: How many orders were placed on the busiest day of the week?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS order_count, d.day_name FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_key = d.date_key WHERE NOT fs.is_cancelled GROUP BY d.day_name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the net revenue in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_ts >= DATE_TRUNC('day', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')

question: How many new customers did the shop get in 2011?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS new_customers FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key WHERE dd.year = 2011 AND fs.customer_key != 0

question: By how much did net revenue change from September 2011 to October 2011 (October minus September)?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue_october, SUM(line_amount) AS net_revenue_september FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key WHERE dd.year = 2011 AND (dd.month = 10 OR dd.month = 9) GROUP BY CASE WHEN dd.month = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY net_revenue_october - net_revenue_september LIMIT 1;

question: What was the gross margin in 2011?
sql: SELECT SUM(line_amount) AS gross_margin FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key WHERE dd.year = 2011 AND NOT fs.is_cancelled

question: Which country was the most profitable after costs?
sql: SELECT dc.country_name, SUM(fs.line_amount) AS total_profit FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key JOIN dim_country dc ON fs.country_key = dc.country_key WHERE fs.is_cancelled = FALSE GROUP BY dc.country_name ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which salesperson closed the most orders?

question: What is the most common reason customers give for a return?
